title: CLI Framework & Command Layer
scope: Identify the CLI framework used and map the full command tree (commands, subcommands, flags).

findings.command_model: Top-level app is a `typer.Typer` instance named `cli` (in kimi_cli/cli/__init__.py) whose `cls` is the custom `LazySubcommandGroup` (subclass of `typer.core.TyperGroup`) defined in `kimi_cli/cli/_lazy_group.py`. Eager top-level commands are registered with `@cli.command()` decorators (e.g. login, logout, term, acp, __background-task-worker, __web-worker). Additional sub-command groups (info, export, mcp, plugin, vis, web) are NOT registered with `add_typer`; instead they are lazily dispatched from a `LazySubcommandGroup.lazy_subcommands` class-level dict mapping group name -> (module_path, attribute_name='cli', help_text). Each entry imports the matching module's `cli` Typer app on first access via `typer.main.get_command(...)`. Within each sub-module, the group itself is a plain `typer.Typer`; leaf subcommands use `@cli.command('name')` while groups that act as single-leaf commands use `@cli.callback(invoke_without_command=True)` (info, vis, web) or `@cli.command(name='export')` (export).

group_structure.root: kimi (typer.Typer, cls=LazySubcommandGroup; root callback `kimi` runs the agent in shell mode)

aliasing.mechanism: Option/flag aliases are declared via multiple flag strings in `typer.Option` (e.g. `--session`/`--resume`/`-S`/`-r`, `--prompt`/`-p`/`--command`/`-c`, `--work-dir`/`-w`, `--yolo`/`--yes`/`-y`/`--auto-approve`, `--model`/`-m`, `--continue`/`-C`, `-h`/`--help`). No Click-style command-name aliases dict or typer `name=[...]` aliases are used. Command dispatch for lazy groups is a custom registry map (LazySubcommandGroup.lazy_subcommands) rather than name aliasing.

proposal.pydantic_v2_pattern: ai-factory can mirror kimi-cli's declarative + lazy-registration pattern using pydantic-v2 as the source of truth: define one pydantic BaseModel per command whose fields are `Annotated[..., typer.Option(...)/typer.Argument(...)]` (so pydantic validates flag types while Typer reads the annotations for parsing); a registry walks each model to synthesize a `typer.Typer` sub-app (`@sub_app.command()` over the model class) and registers it on a root `Typer(cls=...)` group (a `LazySubcommandGroup`-style subclass that overrides `get_command`/`list_commands` to import each sub-app module on first access from a config-driven list, e.g. a `pydantic-settings` `CliPluginSettings` model listing enabled sub-app modules). Flag aliases are then just repeated flag strings in the `typer.Option` metadata, and command aliases (if desired) can be derived from an extra `aliases` pydantic field read at registration time.

notes: Root entrypoint `kimi`/`kimi-cli` console_script -> kimi_cli.__main__:main -> `cli` Typer app in kimi_cli/cli/__init__.py.
Two __main__.py exist: kimi_cli/__main__.py (package, console_script) and kimi_cli/cli/__main__.py (module-level, python -m kimi_cli.cli); both delegate to the same `cli` app.
Lazy load avoids importing heavyweight deps (e.g. toad, web/vis FastAPI servers) until subcommand is invoked.
23 command entries total (1 root + 6 eager + 1 group-as-leaf info + 1 group-as-leaf export + 6 mcp + 4 plugin + 1 vis + 1 web); 2 of the eager commands are hidden internal workers.
